people.role: Master of the ice drills: holds the inner-gate test on the frozen ore tailings
people.backstory: He came to the plum gate in 1150 to duel the founder, lost in two petals and asked to be taught; Lăng Đạp Tuyết (lang_dap_tuyet) taught him the canon for ten years, then gave him the inner-gate test on the tailings ice after the move.

ties.note: he says she is the best sword in the school

tree.intent: Hard Metal first, the blossom late.

people.appearance: A frost-split lip; he sits with his left foot a hand's width forward.

people.role: Seam-finder: walks the old mines of the mountain for iron the forge can use
people.backstory: Trác Thiết Cán (trac_thiet_can) taught her the forge when she was a Luyện Khí miner's girl of Ngân Tuyết Khoáng, then sent her into the old shafts of Hổ Văn Khoáng for a new seam, and never told her why it is urgent. She hoards the best samples in a locked tin under her bunk; Trác forges from the lumps she leaves and cannot tell why the blades chip.

tree.intent: Metal and Earth toughness; she outlasts a collapsed shaft.

build.note: Wears a sword, as the plum gate's canon asks.

people.appearance: Lamp-soot in the lines of her face, and a miner's squint she keeps even in daylight.

people.role: Inner disciple of the ice drills
people.backstory: She passed the five thrusts on the tailings ice on her second try, which Chung Thiết Tuyền (chung_thiet_tuyen) says nobody does, and has wanted to beat Cung Hàn Nhạn (cung_han_nhan) to the fifth petal since. She copies Chung's drill notes for Phó Ngạo Sương's disciples, to buy a place in their yard, and Chung Thiết Tuyền (chung_thiet_tuyen) found his own drill turned against his pupils on the tailings ice.
people.appearance: A bruise shaped like a plum petal on one cheek, which she says she earned.

people.role: Outer disciple at the Plum Gate; tends the grave trees
people.backstory: A Ma Bố boy with chilblains to the knee who would rather tend the grave plums than duel; he and Phí Tầm Mai (phi_tam_mai) keep Lăng Nhược Mai's (lang_nhuoc_mai) tree, and he has never broken a branch. He prunes nothing, so the grave plums are a thicket.
people.appearance: Walks as if every step were on ice, with a pruning knife he never uses.

people.role: Outer disciple of the forge; quenches the school's blades
people.backstory: A petty magistrate's son, he quenches every blade the forge makes in meltwater from the tailings and thinks he should be the smith's heir, not Dư Hổ Văn (du_ho_van), whose only claim is that his family mined the town. Dư Hổ Văn's left palm is shiny where he held it over the quench steam for a laugh.

build.note: Wears a sword, as the plum gate's canon asks.

people.appearance: Forearms speckled with scald scars from the quench, and a neck as thick as a post.

people.role: Outer disciple; carries the lamp for the seam-finder
people.backstory: A quiet boy born at the last diggings of Hổ Văn Khoáng who goes down the dead shafts of Hổ Văn Khoáng behind Dương Tầm Mạch (duong_tam_mach) with the lamp, and can tell iron from tiger-stripe ore by the sound of a hammer.

build.note: Wears a sword, as the plum gate's canon asks.

people.appearance: A tin lamp-cap tied under his chin, and eyes slow to take the daylight.

people.role: Inner disciple of the first disciple
people.backstory: She asked Phó Ngạo Sương (pho_ngao_suong) once what happened on the mountain road in 1162 and was sent to train barefoot until dark; she has not asked again, and asks Ân Lãnh Phong (an_lanh_phong) instead. She tells Ân Lãnh Phong that Phó has already answered her, to draw out what he knows; he repeated it to Phó and was sent to train barefoot for it.
people.appearance: Braid hacked off at the nape, bare feet horn-hard.
